title: 2026 Community Wood Kiln Firings — Salt Chamber
source_quote:
2026 Community Wood Kiln Firings
[...]
2026 Firing Dates:
We offer openings in a rotating sequence alongside class semester releases.
Winter Classes:
February 13th-15th
April 10th-12th
Spring Classes:
May 29th-31st
Summer Classes:
August 7th – 9th
September 11th-13th
Fall Classes:
December 11th -13th
evidence_sentence: The same firings use the kiln's second chamber, where salt is introduced during the firing process.
evidence_quote: in the second chamber salt is introduced. The kiln reaches cone 10 (about 2,400F) in approximately 26 hours.
summary: Participate in the salt chamber of the same noborigama community firings. Your work is loaded in the salt chamber alongside wood-fired work in the first chamber. Same participation terms: kiln share, stoking shifts, loading and unloading help.
bring: Bisque-fired work, leather gloves, dust mask, work gloves, protective eyewear
commitment: Fri glazing 12:30pm–9:30pm, Sat loading 9:30am–2pm, Sat–Sun firing 2pm–4pm, Thu unloading 3–6pm
how_to_join: Register online via the registration link
